email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Luis, saw dbt Labs launch dbt Copilot and pick up Partner of the Year from both Snowflake and Google Cloud.

Momentum like that opens more in-market data teams than your reps can cover before you can hire and ramp, and that gap is where growth pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Luis, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

With Copilot and the partner wins pulling interest, the growth target list expands faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Luis, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Luis, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling growth pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running a growth motion off a big product and partner year is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
